title: Add safe local and external prototypes

steps.action: Add a self-contained HTML prototype from local files.
steps.expected_result: The Saga stores an immutable copy with a verified content digest and entrypoint.

steps.action: Change the authored source and then tamper with the packaged copy.
steps.expected_result: External source changes do not alter the Saga, and packaged tampering fails digest validation.

steps.action: Add an external prototype link and an allowlisted provider embed.
steps.expected_result: The fallback URL and allowlisted embed policy load exactly as authored.

steps.action: Try to add an embed whose provider policy does not match.
steps.expected_result: The unsupported embed is rejected without a prototype record.

expected_result: Local prototypes are immutable digest-verified packages, and external prototypes use supported links or explicit allowlisted embeds.
